description: Na₂Sn(NH₂)₆ crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3 space group. Na is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine equivalent N atoms. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.48-2.86 Å. Sn is bonded in a cuboctahedral geometry to six equivalent N and six equivalent H atoms. All Sn-N bond lengths are 2.56 Å. All Sn-H bond lengths are 2.30 Å. N is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na, one Sn, two equivalent N, and one H atom. Both N-N bond lengths are 1.49 Å. The N-H bond length is 1.72 Å. There are two inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one N and two equivalent H atoms. Both H-H bond lengths are 0.96 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Sn and one H atom. The H-H bond length is 0.78 Å.
